fusions: Prepare the3 contrasts, BF16 mean, shared-sign input contrast and partial norm in a single read of postQ1 rows.
Pack one/two original-W1 points directly from mean/contrast and current schedule.
Average the two original postQ2 vectors into one W2 row perstripe.
Inverse three-direction affine projection plus response, explicit BF16 add/multiply boundaries and residual writeback.
kernel_layout: Four warps and1024features per program; five feature chunks forD, ceil(H/1024) masked chunks for hidden. Fixed before timing; no autotuning/layout sweep. FP fusion disabled to preserve declared arithmetic.
fixed_control: First3958stripe positions. Omit norm scoring/topk and cache fixed schedules; only compute needed fixed contrasts. This is an efficient hardware placement control, not the strongest fixed quality policy.
dynamic_signal: Squared norm of current postQ1 shared input contrast, before expensive W1. Charge partial reduction, topk/sort, complementary indices and maps. No learned selector or value-prediction result.
controls_before_timing: Unfused explicit operation order defines a BF16 reference. Mean,3contrasts, contrast, packedpoints, averagedV2 and inverse/gate/writeback must match numerically exactly; report signed-zero bit differences separately. Stop on any nonzero mismatch.
Partial-norm reduction relative error<=5e-6 versus reference and identical selected stripe IDs required.
All14 Q1/Q2 synthetic-arm boundaries must match original forceFP32 bitwise using the same native BF16 quantizer entry.
Full fused fixed/dynamic outputs must match their own three-direction unfused references numerically exactly and remain finite.
timing: Same random resident tensors, common PyTorch LayerNorm/AdaLN stand-in, Smooth, originalQ1/Q2, all GEMMs, auxiliary operations, schedule, gate and residual included.3warmups then7 rotating/reversing whole-chain CUDA event samples and host elapsed. decision: Measure same-count representation effect, fusion effect and dynamic scheduling cost. Engineering advance requires valid controls and fused dynamic median at least max(0.5ms,3*max arm MAD) faster than unfused dynamic. Report dense/UB1-proxy ratios; historical1.5x is a reference, not evidence of video Pareto success.
